name: export-not-json
description: The asset export answers 200 with an HTML body -- what a proxy or a captive login in front of the console actually returns. json_decode on that aborts the whole run; the guard must print, stop, and schedule nothing. Exactly one request, no PUT, no POST.  The task now ENDS IN ERROR. A primary response the script cannot read means no inventory, which is not an empty one.

error_contains: the asset export returned a non-JSON body
